t: Adal was a Muslim sultanate of the Horn of Africa, rich from the port of Zeila and later ruled from Harar.
Under Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim, firearms helped it overrun much of the Ethiopian highlands between 1529 and 1543.
Ahmad's death at Wayna Daga, then Oromo migrations and Ethiopian victories, reduced Adal to remnant states by 1577.
dyk: The Ethiopian-Adal War drew in both global rivals of the age: about 400 Portuguese musketeers fought for Ethiopia, while Ottoman musketeers fought for Adal.
ev: Sabr ad-Din III founds Adal after returning from exile in Yemen
Sultan Badlay is defeated and killed by Zara Yaqob at the Battle of Gomit
Sultan Abu Bakr moves the capital from Dakkar to Harar
Imam Ahmad routs Lebna Dengel's larger Ethiopian army at Shimbra Kure
Imam Ahmad is killed at Wayna Daga and his coalition collapses
Nur ibn Mujahid kills Emperor Gelawdewos at the Battle of Fatagar
Sarsa Dengel defeats Sultan Muhammad ibn Nasir at the Webi River
The dynasty withdraws to the oasis of Aussa
